messages:
Maya: Quick random q — if your desk plant could talk, what gossip would it spill about you? :laughing:
Ethan: That it's the *real* reason I schedule 3pm meetings — I'm just watering the plant and hiding snacks. :seedling:
Priya: Mine would spill that I sing to it and I'm convinced that's why it survives. 100% guilty. :microphone:
Jordan: It would tell HR that I forget to exhale during meetings. :sweat_smile:
Olga: Oof — mine would reveal that it gets more coffee than me. :coffee:
Devon: @Maya, this deserves a poll. PollBot create: "Plant gossip" options: "Snack hiding", "Secret singer", "Steals coffee", "Overwatered but loved"
PollBot: Poll created — vote by replying with the option text.
Ethan: voting: Snack hiding
Priya: Secret singer
Olga: Steals coffee
Jordan: Overwatered but loved
Maya: Winner so far: still a tie. Also, bonus: what would you name your plant if it could choose? I'll start: "Sir Photos-a-lot".
Priya: "Leaf Erickson"
Ethan: "Chlorophyllip"
Devon: "Supervisor"
Olga: "Karen (but make it fern)"
Maya: Okay this thread made my afternoon. :heart:
